answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the timber of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the comet of a task receipt, and the plume is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
